description: Fan prediction on /matches/: when the next match is open (club playing, kick-off set and ahead) the form must be there, the steppers stay within 0-15, and sending shows the tally and the visitor's pick (sent only on localhost, never to production); when the kick-off time is not set the box says so; otherwise there is no form

steps.eval: (async () => { const d = await (await fetch('/api/matches')).json(); const n = d.next; const open = !!n && !n.timeTbd && new Date(n.date) > Date.now() && [n.home?.id, n.away?.id].map(String).includes('86'); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && document.querySelector('#predict').hidden; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const box = document.querySelector('#predict'); const f = box.querySelector('form'); if (open) return !box.hidden && !!f; if (n?.timeTbd) return !box.hidden && !f && /\S/.test(box.textContent); return !f; })()

(async () => { const d = await (await fetch('/api/matches')).json(); const n = d.next; const open = !!n && !n.timeTbd && new Date(n.date) > Date.now() && [n.home?.id, n.away?.id].map(String).includes('86'); if (!open) return true; const f = document.querySelector('#predict form'); const row = f.querySelectorAll('.predict-row')[0]; const [less, more] = row.querySelectorAll('button'); const out = row.querySelector('output'); for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) less.click(); const low = out.textContent === '0'; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) more.click(); return low && out.textContent === '15' && /\S/.test(less.getAttribute('aria-label')); })()

(async () => { const d = await (await fetch('/api/matches')).json(); const n = d.next; const open = !!n && !n.timeTbd && new Date(n.date) > Date.now() && [n.home?.id, n.away?.id].map(String).includes('86'); if (!open || location.hostname !== 'localhost') return true; const f = document.querySelector('#predict form'); f.querySelectorAll('.predict-row')[0].querySelectorAll('button')[0].click(); f.requestSubmit(); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && document.querySelector('#predict form'); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const box = document.querySelector('#predict'); return !box.querySelector('form') && !!box.querySelector('.predict-mine, .muted'); })()
